subject: Private plan listing + negotiated commercials (Tribeca Financial)
messages:
From: Samira Khan <procurement@tribeca.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Li <alex.li@tribeca.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private plan listing + initial terms (Tribeca Financial)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. Tribeca is interested in a Private Plan listing on Azure Marketplace for a regional deployment (US + EU data residency) and we'd like to move to commercial terms quickly. Attached is our standard procurement term sheet with the items we need to confirm: invoice routing to our AP (ap@tribeca.com) and PO workflow, 60-day net payment terms, confirmation of EU data residency for EU tenants, a quarterly SLA credit mechanism, and a negotiated indemnity cap. We also want co-sell registration and confirmation that co-sell revenue split mechanics are supported for private offers.

Can you confirm Redwood can accept these or propose redlines? We need a counter-signed sheet by Oct 8 to align to our procurement window.

Attachments: TRB-Azure-PrivatePlan-Termsheet-v1.pdf

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Procurement
Tribeca Financial

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Private plan listing + initial terms (Tribeca Financial)

Folks — forwarding Tribeca's term sheet. Quick asks: legal review on indemnity/liability, procurement on payment terms & invoice routing, and pricing/sales on co-sell split and any onboarding credit we should offer for private plans.

Suggested next steps: Kimberly, can you provide redlines? Ben, please propose compromise commercials we can present back (I want to avoid losing the co-sell opportunity). Laura, tag finance on how to handle invoice routing via Azure Private Offer + reseller if needed.

Vivek
VP, Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Private plan listing + initial terms (Tribeca Financial)

Vivek / Ben / Laura —

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed Tribeca's sheet and attached a redlines doc with position recommendations. High level:
- Indemnity: we should accept IP indemnity and narrow third-party claims; decline broad general indemnities tied to customer data processing.
- Liability cap: propose 12 months of fees (not unlimited) and exclude willful misconduct.
- Payment terms: 45 days net is reasonable; 60 days is a material risk for cashflow — open to 60 days if they accept a small onboarding fee or prepayment for first month.
- SLA credits: cap credits at 10% of quarterly invoice; provide objective definitions (latency, availability).
- Data residency: we can commit to EU residency for EU tenants with Azure region pinning and a data processing addendum (DPA).

I attached: Azure-Private-Plan-Redlines-ky.docx with track changes. If Ben wants to offer commercial concessions (credits, co-sell split), we should fold those into the commercial sheet and then circulate a counter-signature path (DocuSign + Azure private offer setting).

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Azure-Private-Plan-Redlines-ky.docx

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Private plan listing + initial terms (Tribeca Financial)

Team —

Appreciate the quick legal review, Kim. Tradeoffs from Commercial's view: Tribeca is strategic (large potential ACV, good channel for co-sell). My recommended compromise to keep the deal moving:
- Accept 45-day net as Kimberly suggests as baseline. If Tribeca insists on 60 days, we provide a one-time onboarding credit of $25,000 and require a 12-month committed spend minimum (minimum committed ARR or SOW of $120k).
- Co-sell revenue split: request 80/20 in our favor for the first 12 months (standard for private offers where Redwood owns the product and scale is early). We can revisit after the initial period.
- Invoice routing: we can support invoice to ap@tribeca.com through our reseller partner CloudWave (they handle payout and Marketplace fee reconciliation). Laura, can you confirm ops flow and whether this will affect billing term setup in Azure?
- DocuSign: I can prepare a commercial exhibit that reflects the above and include a DocuSign link for quick signature.

Related: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5421/DEAL-TRB-2026-042 (I added the onboarding credit as a conditional line item).

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5421/DEAL-TRB-2026-042

---

From: Samira Khan <procurement@tribeca.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Li <alex.li@tribeca.com>, Michael O'Neill <michael.oneill@tribeca.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Private plan listing + initial terms (Tribeca Financial)

Vivek,

Thanks — we reviewed Redwood's proposed tradeoffs. We are comfortable with the redlines Kimberly proposed and the 45-day net payment term as a baseline. We'd like to keep the 60-day option on the table should we pursue a multi-month PO consolidation (our treasury cycle sometimes requires it).

Regarding the onboarding credit: we prefer to keep that separate from payment cadence. If Redwood needs a guaranteed minimum for 60 days, we can consider a short-term commitment but would prefer the onboarding credit to be conditional upon meeting an activation milestone.

Invoice routing will be to ap@tribeca.com; PO format attached (tribeca_PO_template.docx). Please prepare a counter-signed term sheet reflecting: 45d baseline (60d on request with commit), SLA credit cap of 10% as Kimberly suggested, co-sell mechanics described, and data residency DPA. We'll need this counter-signed to generate our internal PO.

Can you send a DocuSign link for the countered sheet and confirm technical steps for Azure Private Offer listing (who does the co-sell registration, what info CloudWave needs)?

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Procurement
Tribeca Financial

Attachment: tribeca_PO_template.docx

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <procurement@tribeca.com>, Alex Li <alex.li@tribeca.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Private plan listing + initial terms (Tribeca Financial)

Samira / Alex —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and flexibility. Kim, Ben, Laura and I aligned on the language. I attached a consolidated counter-term sheet that:
- Sets net 45 days as standard, allows 60 days if Tribeca executes a 12-month committed spend addendum (or accepts the $25k onboarding credit structure tied to activation).
- Caps SLA credits at 10% of quarterly bill, with objective SLOs defined.
- Sets liability cap at 12 months of fees and limits indemnity to IP and third-party claims as described in Kimberly's redlines.
- Confirms EU data residency via Azure region pinning and a DPA to be executed alongside the private offer.

Next steps:
1) Samira — please confirm PO number and whether Tribeca will sign the 12-month commitment addendum if you elect the 60-day payment path.
2) Alex — I will send a DocuSign link for the consolidated counter-term sheet after Kimberly gives a final sign-off on wording.
3) Ben/Laura — I'll coordinate with CloudWave on invoice routing; Laura, please advise if any payout terms or marketplace setup items will delay Azure Private Offer listing.

Target to have signed by Oct 8 to meet Tribeca's procurement window.

DocuSign (pending legal sign-off): https://www.docusign.com/prepare/TRB-2026-042
Azure private offer guide: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Marketplace/PrivateOffers

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachment: TRB-Azure-PrivatePlan-Termsheet-v1-counter.pdf
